## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / dependency update
- [ ] New feature

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched for an existing issue or pull request covering this change.
- [ ] `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behaviour or versions change.
- [ ] The public-content check, Hadolint, and Gitleaks are all green.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private addresses, or personal data were added.
- [ ] The maintainer attribution “Daniel G. Cosenza from FNX Labs” is preserved.
- [ ] No published release or tag was deleted and no history was rewritten.
